shortDescription: Schedule periodic scrub of ZFS pools.

options.name: day
options.description: Day of month when the task should run, in cron format. This is a comma-separated list of integer ranges, e.g., "10", "1-5", "1,3,7-10".

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the task should be enabled

options.name: hour
options.description: Hour when the task should run, in cron format. This is a comma-separated list of integer ranges.

options.name: minute
options.description: This parameter is ignored, and exists only for compatibility with builtin.cron.

options.name: month
options.description: Month when the task should run, in cron format. This is a comma-separated list of month names or numbers, e.g., "jan,feb,mar".

options.name: pool
options.description: Name of the pool to scrub. Only one scrub task is allowed per pool.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the scrub should exist or not.

options.name: threshold
options.description: Minimum number of days between successful scrub tasks. For instance, if you schedule a job to run every day, but set threshold to 7, the job will check every day to see whether it should run, but will only actually run once every 7 days.

options.name: weekday
options.description: Day of week when the task should run, in cron format. This is a comma-separated list of day numbers of abbreviations, e.g. "1", "1,5", "sun,mon".
